title: RecordingFrameLine
description: One line of frames.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): one line per ARFrame, written by the Swift recorder. Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: frame and t strictly increase, and every candidate kept has its files and a blur line.

transform.description: ARKit's camera.transform at this frame, as in poses.jsonl.

intrinsics.description: [fx, fy, cx, cy] in pixels, for arkit.video_format's image size in recording.json.

tracking.description: ARKit's tracking state, as in poses.jsonl: normal, notAvailable, or limited:<reason>.

light.description: ARKit's light estimate, or null when it has none.

gap.description: Frames ARKit skipped since the last line, from the time between them at the video format's rate; 0 for the first line.

candidate.description: null when the frame is not a candidate.

sharpness.description: The candidate's pre-blur sharpness score, or null (not a candidate, or not measured, as in lean).

exposure.title: FrameExposure
exposure.description: The camera's exposure for this frame.

intensity_lm.description: Ambient intensity in lumens (1000 is neutral).

candidate.title: CandidateStatus
candidate.description: What became of a candidate. keyframe: chosen as a keyframe (in its bundle). kept: written to candidates/ through writeBlurredJPEG. dropped:profile: the profile keeps no candidates (lean). dropped:heat, dropped:backpressure, dropped:disk: dropped under heat, a full queue or low disk. dropped:blur: a detector failed, so it was never written.
